# Temporal chart237 continuation (draft)

Exact native and directed-price candidate: **κ = 0.003643989339627**, gain **0.000000550833208 over #7145** at db8f31c4a1d9e191976e2c92951e6d2dea886a27.

Two timed gathers and six later injections at chart237 split a rank-nine helper into four and five, using pivot1082 at cut36813. One paid rank-six path of role820 changes to ranks one and five. Two owned buffers are explicit. Native delta is T4 +1,T5 +1,T9 −1 and P1 +1,P5 +1,P6 −1. All17 native occurrences are priced.

The complete33-file predecessor export and nested sources/notices are retained. The package reconstructs every source/candidate byte, checks the arbitrary-input adjoint and owned inventory, and compares every early receipt field from both directed price engines.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-temporal-chart237-continuation/verify_early.py
```

Fresh forward/grid, physical chart/phase, ordinary/precision, complete caller/catalogue and registered replay checks remain **pending**. This draft can still be rejected. Five inherited assumptions remain: native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. Local checks do not establish hosted CI, maintainer admission, independent human/formal acceptance, or a full multiplication theorem.
